artifact: PHASE 4D REMEDIATION §16 - the measured cost of the corrected composition model
stateEvaluationsRule: one opening evaluation plus one per ledger-affecting effect: n + 1, linear in the number of effects
singleDrawUnchanged: a transaction with one draw and no adjustment still costs 2 state evaluations, exactly as before the remediation, so the common case pays nothing

knownQuadratic.statement: each recomputation scans the ledger, which grows by one row per draw, so ledger scanning is quadratic in the number of ledger-affecting effects. This is disclosed rather than asserted away.
knownQuadratic.optimisationNotTaken: an incremental usage accumulator would make this linear, but it would re-derive Phase-4C arithmetic inside Phase 4D and the two layers could then drift. Correctness first; the optimisation belongs behind a proof of equivalence.

noWallClockAssertion: no correctness or performance claim in this phase rests on elapsed time; every figure above is a structural counter
